# Vendored snapshot of pgsg_1

Minimal copy of the pgsg_1 code used by this repository (PGSGv2Model, PLSModel,
Mango DMC loader, NIR preprocessor), created by `scripts/vendor_pgsg1.py`.
Do not edit; regenerate instead. SHA-256 of every file and the source commit are
in MANIFEST.json. Use it with `--pgsg1-root vendor/pgsg_1`.
